description.value: Triple O's is a BC-founded quick-service burger chain known for fresh Canadian beef burgers, hand-scooped milkshakes, and thick-cut Kennebec fries with the brand's signature Triple O sauce. This Merritt outpost is co-located inside a Chevron gas station on De Wolf Way, making it a logical fuel-and-food stop for cyclists on the Nicola Valley or Coquihalla corridor. The restaurant offers both takeout and drive-thru service.
